internal.title: Incident Report: flagd Service Error Rate Spike
internal.body:
At 10:38 UTC on 2026-11-08, the flagd service triggered an alert due to a 100% error rate. Despite multiple diagnosis rounds and replanning attempts, no specific root cause or hypothesis was supported by the evidence. The issue was escalated to the on-call engineer at 10:57 UTC for further investigation. No resolution or recovery was confirmed at the time of escalation.

Timeline:
- 10:38:04: Alert received for high error rate in flagd.
- 10:57:45 to 10:57:54: Multiple diagnosis rounds with replanning; no hypothesis supported.
- 10:57:58: Escalation to on-call engineer due to lack of supported hypotheses.

Current status: Under investigation by engineering team.

No impact beyond the flagd service was detected, and no specific error cause was identified from logs or traces.

external.body: Between 10:38 and 10:57 UTC on 2026-11-08, the flagd service experienced elevated error rates, which may have impacted service availability or functionality. Our engineering team is actively investigating the issue. We will provide updates as more information becomes available.

lessons.lesson: When a service shows a 100% error rate but no specific error cause can be identified from logs or traces, escalate promptly to on-call engineers for deeper investigation.
lessons.applies_when: A service experiences a complete error rate spike with no identifiable cause from initial diagnostics.

action_items: Enhance logging and monitoring for flagd to capture more detailed error context.
Review and improve diagnostic procedures for unknown error causes in critical services.
